summary: Spec-review of #57: the plan stands (Henry Ford, build-1 haiku high engine, build-2 sonnet medium page off the ladder up, review opus low by coin); steps.json unchanged. Two fixes: the_save_version_pins_the_rules now pins a fourth digest, seed 2 led by the scripted game of `digest --lead`, since the watched digests never run the player's orders where camp and scout notes and alerts are added; and bench.md takes the best of three runs so the 10% bar isn't runner noise. Checked: stats::digest hashes the serialized World, so notes, last-turn alert candidates and Event fields must stay #[serde(skip)]/off World's serialized state as the spec says; tag prototype/merge4 exists; no saves are checked in, so refusing versionless saves breaks no fixture; ci.yml's js matrix still lists merge4, which the archive's package.json keeps green.

decisions.decision: Pin a led digest (seed 2, digest --lead) beside the three watched ones.
decisions.why: The rules a led civ runs (player orders on camp and scout) would otherwise go unpinned by the no-rule-change proof.

decisions.decision: Bench takes the best of three runs.
decisions.why: A 10% bar on one run of a shared CI runner fails on noise.

ideas.title: Drop merge4 from ci.yml's js matrix
ideas.body: Once archived, merge4's CI row only echoes 'archived'; the owner can drop it with hex-economy's and delete both folders.
